answer: The delta test I would run is Verified wildlife rehabilitator licence with wildlife trust attestation: a licence the trust renews after release audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence the trust renews after release audits — so privacy survives, and the dune is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the pulse of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
